filed.label: Filed
filed.definition: Lodged with the authority and not yet taken up.

verification.label: In verification
verification.definition: With the authority's secretariat for completeness and eligibility checks before appraisal.

administrative.label: Administrative
administrative.definition: Fee demands, payments and pollution control board comments - steps a proposal must clear that decide nothing about it.

query.label: Under query
query.definition: The authority has raised written questions - Essential or Additional Details Sought - and the proposal waits on the proponent's reply.

appraisal.label: In appraisal
appraisal.definition: Before an expert appraisal committee or the authority that acts on its recommendation.

decided.label: Decided
decided.definition: The authority has granted or refused the clearance or the terms of reference applied for.

closed.label: Closed without decision
closed.definition: Withdrawn by the proponent, returned by the authority, or removed from the register.

other.label: Other
other.definition: A recorded position that does not fall in the ordinary passage from filing to decision.

ec_granted.label: Environmental clearance granted
ec_granted.definition: Prior environmental clearance has been granted for the project.

ec_rejected.label: Environmental clearance refused
ec_rejected.definition: The application for prior environmental clearance was refused.

tor_granted.label: Terms of Reference granted
tor_granted.definition: Terms of Reference for the environmental impact assessment have been framed and issued for this project.

standard_tor_granted.label: Standard Terms of Reference granted
standard_tor_granted.definition: Terms of Reference have been issued from the published standard set for the project's category, without project-specific framing.

tor_rejected.label: Terms of Reference refused
tor_rejected.definition: The application for Terms of Reference was refused.

granted.label: Granted
granted.definition: The source records that the application was granted without naming the instrument granted.

form9_approved.label: Form 9 approved
form9_approved.definition: An application made on Form 9 was approved.

form9_rejected.label: Form 9 refused
form9_rejected.definition: An application made on Form 9 was refused.

form9_accepted.label: Form 9 accepted
form9_accepted.definition: An application made on Form 9 was accepted for processing.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.definition: Lodged with the authority and awaiting first action.

draft.label: Draft
draft.definition: Begun by the proponent and not yet submitted.

intimated.label: Intimated
intimated.definition: The authority has been notified of the proposal.

ms_verification.label: With the member secretary
ms_verification.definition: With the member secretary of the appraisal authority for verification.

under_verification.label: Under verification
under_verification.definition: The authority is checking the application for completeness and eligibility before appraisal.

under_verification_sceia.label: Under verification with SCEIA
under_verification_sceia.definition: Under verification with the State Coastal Environment Impact Assessment authority.

under_examination.label: Under examination
under_examination.definition: The authority is examining the application.

under_examination_sceia.label: Under examination with SCEIA
under_examination_sceia.definition: Under examination with the State Coastal Environment Impact Assessment authority.

under_processing.label: Under processing with the authority
under_processing.definition: With the authority for processing, without a finer position recorded.

pending_ms_seiaa.label: Pending with the member secretary, SEIAA
pending_ms_seiaa.definition: Awaiting action by the member secretary of the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority.

pending_ms_saeia.label: Pending with the member secretary (SAEIA)
pending_ms_saeia.definition: Awaiting action by the member secretary of the authority the register records as SAEIA. The source never expands the abbreviation. It appears on 18 proposals, all from West Bengal, every one of which names SEIAA as its issuing authority - so this may well be the same body under a second label. It is recorded as written rather than merged into SEIAA, because the record does not establish that, and an invented expansion would be a claim about an institution rather than about the data.

eds_raised.label: Essential details sought
eds_raised.definition: The authority has asked the proponent in writing for essential details and the proposal waits on the reply.
raw: eds raised by ms to ua

eds_replied.label: Essential details supplied
eds_replied.definition: The proponent has answered the authority's request for essential details.

eds_under_examination.label: Essential details under examination
eds_under_examination.definition: The authority is examining the proponent's reply to its request for essential details.

ads_raised.label: Additional details sought
ads_raised.definition: The authority has asked the proponent in writing for additional details and the proposal waits on the reply.

referred_to_eac.label: Referred to the Expert Appraisal Committee
referred_to_eac.definition: Sent to the central Expert Appraisal Committee for appraisal.

referred_to_seac.label: Referred to the State Expert Appraisal Committee
referred_to_seac.definition: Sent to the State Expert Appraisal Committee for appraisal.

referred_to_seiaa.label: Referred to SEIAA
referred_to_seiaa.definition: Sent to the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority, which decides on the committee's recommendation.

referred_to_saeia.label: Referred to SAEIA
referred_to_saeia.definition: Sent to the authority the register records as SAEIA. The source never expands the abbreviation. First seen in the 24 September 2026 sweep, on 131 proposals, all from Andhra Pradesh, every one of which names SEIAA as its issuing authority - so this may be the same body under a second label, as with the member-secretary stage above. It is recorded as written rather than merged into SEIAA, because the record does not establish that.

accepted_referred_to_eac.label: Accepted and referred to the Expert Appraisal Committee
accepted_referred_to_eac.definition: Accepted by the authority and sent to the central Expert Appraisal Committee.
raw: proposal accepted and referred to eac

accepted_referred_to_seac.label: Accepted and referred to the State Expert Appraisal Committee
accepted_referred_to_seac.definition: Accepted by the authority and sent to the State Expert Appraisal Committee.
raw: proposal accepted and referred to seac

accepted_referred_to_sceia.label: Accepted and referred to SCEIA
accepted_referred_to_sceia.definition: Accepted by the authority and sent to the State Coastal Environment Impact Assessment authority.
raw: proposal accepted and referred to sceia

mom_pending.label: Minutes of meeting pending
mom_pending.definition: The appraisal committee has met and its minutes are not yet issued.
raw: pending at ms for mom creation

mom_published.label: Minutes of meeting published
mom_published.definition: The appraisal committee's minutes have been issued.

public_hearing_examination.label: Public hearing under examination
public_hearing_examination.definition: The record of the statutory public hearing is before the authority.

stage1_fc_awaited.label: Stage-I forest clearance awaited
stage1_fc_awaited.definition: The proposal waits on first-stage clearance under the Forest (Conservation) Act before it can proceed.

pulled_back.label: Pulled back by the proponent
pulled_back.definition: Taken back by the proponent before decision.

withdrawal_request_accepted.label: Withdrawal accepted
withdrawal_request_accepted.definition: The proponent asked to withdraw and the authority agreed.

pending_ms_withdraw.label: Withdrawal request pending
pending_ms_withdraw.definition: The proponent has asked to withdraw and the authority has not yet acted on the request.
raw: pending at ms for proposal withdraw
pending at ms for proposal withdraw request

returned_in_present_form.label: Returned in its present form
returned_in_present_form.definition: Returned to the proponent by the authority without a decision on the merits, to be refiled.

returned_to_ua.label: Returned to the user agency
returned_to_ua.definition: Sent back to the applying agency by the authority.

delisted.label: Delisted
delisted.definition: Removed from the register by the authority.

violation_reported.label: Violation reported
violation_reported.definition: Recorded against the proposal as a reported violation of the environmental clearance regime.

unrecorded.label: Not recorded
unrecorded.definition: The register carries no status for this proposal.

ms_verification_completed.label: Member secretary verification completed
ms_verification_completed.definition: The member secretary has finished verifying the application.

examination_completed.label: Examination completed
examination_completed.definition: The authority has finished examining the application.

proposal_acceptance.label: Accepted
proposal_acceptance.definition: The authority has accepted the application for processing.

eds_examination_completed.label: Essential details examination completed
eds_examination_completed.definition: The authority has finished examining the reply to its request for essential details.

ads_replied.label: Additional details supplied
ads_replied.definition: The proponent has answered the authority's request for additional details.

processed_by_ms_seiaa.label: Processed by the member secretary, SEIAA
processed_by_ms_seiaa.definition: Acted on by the member secretary of the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority and passed onward.

processed_by_ms_seac.label: Processed by the member secretary, SEAC
processed_by_ms_seac.definition: Acted on by the member secretary of the State Expert Appraisal Committee and passed onward.

forwarded_to_spcb.label: Forwarded to the pollution control board
forwarded_to_spcb.definition: The member secretary has sent the proposal to the State Pollution Control Board or Pollution Control Committee for its part.
raw: forwarded to ms spcb/pcc by ms

comments_furnished.label: Pollution control board comments furnished
comments_furnished.definition: The State Pollution Control Board or Pollution Control Committee has given its comments on the proposal.

comments_late.label: Pollution control board comments not furnished in time
comments_late.definition: The board did not give its comments within the period allowed.

demand_note_raised.label: Fee demand raised
demand_note_raised.definition: The board has raised a demand for the processing fee.
raw: demand note raised by ms spcb/pcc to pp

demand_note_late.label: Fee demand not raised in time
demand_note_late.definition: The board did not raise its fee demand within the period allowed.
raw: demand note not raised on time

payment_furnished.label: Payment details furnished
payment_furnished.definition: The proponent has supplied evidence of payment of the fee.
raw: payment details furnished by pp to ms spcb/pcc

payment_approved.label: Payment approved
payment_approved.definition: The board has accepted the proponent's payment.

payment_rejected.label: Payment rejected
payment_rejected.definition: The board has refused the proponent's payment.

transferred_to_state.label: Transferred to the state
transferred_to_state.definition: Moved from central to state appraisal.

transferred_to_ministry.label: Transferred to the ministry
transferred_to_ministry.definition: Moved from state to central appraisal.

transferred_to_sceia.label: Transferred to SCEIA
transferred_to_sceia.definition: Moved to the State Coastal Environment Impact Assessment authority on expiry of the appraisal committee's term.
raw: transferred to sceia due to seac/seiaa expiry

transferred_from_sceia.label: Transferred back from SCEIA
transferred_from_sceia.definition: Returned from the coastal authority after the appraisal committee was reconstituted.
raw: transferred from sceia to seac after reconstitution of seac/seiaa

parked.label: Parked by the authority
parked.definition: Set aside by the authority without a decision.

reopen_requested.label: Reopening requested
reopen_requested.definition: The proponent has asked for the proposal to be reopened.

reopened.label: Reopened for reconsideration
reopened.definition: Reopened by the authority for reconsideration.

delisted_by_system.label: Delisted automatically
delisted_by_system.definition: Removed from the register by the portal itself rather than by a decision of the authority, on lapse of a time limit.

processed_by_ms.label: Processed by the member secretary
processed_by_ms.definition: Acted on by the member secretary and passed onward, without the source naming which authority.

processed_by_ms_sceia.label: Processed by the member secretary, SCEIA
processed_by_ms_sceia.definition: Acted on by the member secretary of the State Coastal Environment Impact Assessment authority and passed onward.

processed_by_ms_saeia.label: Processed by the member secretary, SAEIA
processed_by_ms_saeia.definition: Acted on by the member secretary of the authority the register calls SAEIA, and passed onward.

transferred_from_saeia.label: Transferred from SAEIA to SEIAA
transferred_from_saeia.definition: Returned from SAEIA to the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority after the appraisal committee was reconstituted.
raw: transferred from saeia to seiaa after reconstitution of seac/seiaa

transferred_to_saeia.label: Transferred to SAEIA
transferred_to_saeia.definition: Moved to the State Authority for Environment Impact Assessment on expiry of the appraisal committee's term.
raw: transferred to saeia due to seac/seiaa expiry

stage1_fc_uploaded.label: Stage-I forest clearance uploaded
stage1_fc_uploaded.definition: First-stage clearance under the Forest (Conservation) Act has been filed against the proposal.

pending_ms_seac.label: Pending with the member secretary, SEAC
pending_ms_seac.definition: Awaiting action by the member secretary of the State Expert Appraisal Committee.

pending_seiaa.label: Pending with SEIAA
pending_seiaa.definition: Awaiting action by the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority.

unclassified.label: Not classified
unclassified.definition: A status the register has begun using that this registry does not yet define. The raw text is shown as filed and is never folded into another position.
